subject: Rebuild Westside Watch homepage from zero on verified existing board
body: Target existing live Penpot board ID fca4e052-7a4d-80fd-8008-8f9d0e6b9771. Use installed Penpot AI Kit instructions. This is CLEAN_START on the existing verified board: inspect the exact board, remove all of its old homepage children, rename it exactly `00 — Westside Watch Homepage — CLEAN START`, and rebuild the homepage from zero inside that same board. Do not create another board and do not copy old children. Follow AI Kit discipline: inspect/router first; make the smallest useful mutations; validate structure after cleanup and after build stages; export exact board; visually self-review; revise obvious defects before completion. Cormorant Garamond English intent, Noto Serif TC Chinese intent. Restrained masthead/navigation, strong editorial hero, generous whitespace, fine rules, asymmetry, 5:8 visual relationships, stone/paper/light feeling, real Chinese editorial module. No SaaS cards, rounded dashboard UI, generic template look, or decorative gold overload. All elements must remain editable native Penpot layers. Acceptance: exact board is visibly transformed; old children are gone; new board name exact; real child structure exists; exact-board PNG succeeds; visual review passes after a review checkpoint. Return board ID/name/child count, cleanup evidence, build checkpoints, export evidence, visual verdict. Do not claim success without actual mutation and visual evidence.
